Leave Balance calculation algorithm analyzed in OneHub. The balance consists of the next indicators:

carry over days from previous periods
other net contributions, positive and negative
absence days, planned and used

net_entitlement = accrual + carryover + other - absence

31-dec-2025 - end of year in OneHub (cannot be changed by the user)
26-feb-2025 - current date in EBS (can be changed by the user)
Leave Balances on different effective dates may differ significantly.

Creating a Separate Listener for Your Application , Yes, this is a safe and effective approach.

Creating a dedicated listener for the Azure application isolates connection handling and parameters for that app.
This ensures tuning (such as increased timeouts) does not impact other applications, which continue using the default listener and settings.
This is a supported and common practice in environments where particular applications have different networking or connection requirements.

Yes, increasing the timeout values to 120 seconds is safe and supported.

You can independently set INBOUND_CONNECT_TIMEOUT in both listener.ora (per-listener) and SQLNET.INBOUND_CONNECT_TIMEOUT in sqlnet.ora (at the Oracle Net layer).
The value can be safely set to 120 seconds (or even higher if needed) without negative side effects. Most applications will not be affected by this, but it means the server will wait longer before dropping half-open or slow connections.

Regards,

Description:
في البداية يطيب لنا أن نتقدم إلى سيادتكم بوافر التحية و الإحترام ، بالإشارة إلى الموضوع أعلاه ، يرجى العلم بأنه تم إغلاق نظام aderp adgov عن كافة الموظفين في بلدية مدينة العين ونظراً لتفعيل نظام العمل الميداني لفئة من الموظفين في النظام فأنه يتعذر عليهم إثبات حضورهم و إنصرافهم من خلال تطبيق onehub حيث أن الخدمة غير متاحة في هذا التطبيق ، يرجى التكرم بالإيعاز للمعنيين معالجة الإشكالية بإحدى البنود الموضحه ادناه : -
1. إعادة تفعيل تطبيق aderp adgov لكافة موظفي بلدية مدينة العين .
